summary: This XML file defines a custom ribbon interface for Microsoft Office that adds a new 'demo Ribbon' tab to the ribbon toolbar. The tab contains a Parameters group with a dropdown menu for selecting a period, and it wires up several callbacks to a VBA module called modToolbar_cbxPeriod to populate the dropdown and handle user selections.

explanations.1: This declares the XML namespace, which tells Office this is a custom UI definition file following Microsoft's 2009 schema.
explanations.4: The insertBeforeMso attribute positions this custom tab right before the standard Home tab in the ribbon instead of appending it to the end.
explanations.6: The onAction callback fires when a user selects an item; the other callbacks handle populating the dropdown list (getItemCount, getItemID, getItemLabel) and retrieving which item is currently selected (getSelectedItemID).
